title_en: How the Dominant Jurisprudential Mentality in Shi'i Thought Led to the Neglect of Biographical Evaluation for Many Narrators of Religious Knowledge

summary: His Eminence the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses how the prevailing jurisprudential mentality in Shi'i thought resulted in neglecting biographical evaluation (rijal) for many narrators of religious knowledge.
